blocks.text: ח׳ אֶחָד הוּא אֱלֹהֵינוּ הוּא אָבִינוּ הוּא מַלְכֵּנוּ הוּא מוֹשִׁיעֵנוּ. וְהוּא יַשְׁמִיעֵנוּ בְּרַחֲמָיו שֵׁנִית לְעֵינֵי כָּל־חַי לִהְיוֹת לָכֶם לֵאלֹהִים:
קו״ח אֲנִי יְיָ אֱלֹהֵיכֶם:
בפֿפֿד״מ אין אומרים כאן אדיר אדירנו.
ק׳ אַדִּיר אַדִּירֵנוּ יְיָ אֲדֹנֵינוּ מָה אַדִּיר שִׁמְךָ בְּכָל הָאָרֶץ: וְהָיָה יְיָ לְמֶלֶךְ עַל כָּל הָאָרֶץ בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא יִהְיֶה יְיָ אֶחָד וּשְׁמוֹ אֶחָד:

ק׳ תְּהִלּוֹת כְּבוֹדְךָ, אָמְצְךָ מְלֹא כָל הָאָרֶץ. שִׁמְעֲךָ דִּין מִשָּׁמַיִם, בְּכֵן יָרְאָה וְשָׁקְטָה הָאָרֶץ. רַעַשׁ יוֹם מִשְׁפָּט, גָּעֲשׁוּ (נ״א גֵּעַשׁ) תְּהוֹמוֹת הָאָרֶץ. קוֹל שׁוֹפָר חָזָק, דִּבֵּר וַיִּקְרָא אָרֶץ. צְבִי לַצַּדִּיק בְּזֶמֶר, הִשְׁמִיעָה כְּנַף הָאָרֶץ. פַּחַד וָפַחַת וָפַח, וּפַלָּצוּת יַבְעִיתוּ אָרֶץ. עֵת תָּקוּם לַמִּשְׁפָּט, זְעוֹם כָּל אַפְסֵי אָרֶץ. ח׳ סֹלּוּ פַּנּוּ (נ״א סוּרוּ מִנִּי) דֶּרֶךְ יְנוֹבְבוּ, חֲרֵדִים מֵחֶרְדַּת הָאָרֶץ. נָאוֹר וְאַדִּיר, טַעַם תָּשִׁיב לָאָרֶץ. מַה תִּירְאִי אֲדָמָה, יָרִיעוּ תַּחְתִּיּוֹת אָרֶץ:
קו״ח לְהִתְוַדַּע וּלְהִגָּלוֹת, כִּי הוּא מֶלֶךְ עַל כָּל הָאָרֶץ. כְּמוֹ פֵּאֲרוּהוּ מֵאָז בַּשַּׁחַק, יֻרְשׁוּ בְּחוּנָיו לְפָאֲרוֹ בָּאָרֶץ:
ק׳ אַדִּיר אַדִּירֵנוּ יְיָ אֲדֹנֵינוּ מָה אַדִּיר שִׁמְךָ בְּכָל הָאָרֶץ: וְהָיָה יְיָ לְמֶלֶךְ עַל כָּל הָאָרֶץ בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא יִהְיֶה יְיָ אֶחָד וּשְׁמוֹ אֶחָד:
ח׳ וּבְדִבְרֵי קָדְשְׁךָ כָּתוּב לֵאמֹר.
קו״ח יִמְלֹךְ יְיָ לְעוֹלָם אֱלֹהַיִךְ צִיּוֹן לְדֹר וָדֹר הַלְלוּיָהּ:
ח׳ לְדֹר וָדֹר נַגִּיד גָּדְלֶךָ וּלְנֵצַח נְצָחִים קְדֻשָּׁתְךָ נַקְדִּישׁ וְשִׁבְחֲךָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ מִפִּינוּ לֹא יָמוּשׁ לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד כִּי אֵל מֶלֶךְ גָּדוֹל וְקָדוֹשׁ אָתָּה.
כִּי מַקְדִּישֶׁיךָ בִּקְדֻשָּׁתְךָ (נ״א כערכך) קִדַּשְׁתָּ. נָאֶה לְקָדוֹשׁ פְּאֵר מִקְּדוֹשִׁים. וּבְכֵן יִתְקַדַּשׁ שִׁמְךָ יְיָ
אֱלֹהֵינוּ. עַל יִשְׂרָאֵל עַמֶּךָ. וְעַל יְרוּשָׁלַיִם עִירֶךָ. וְעַל צִיּוֹן מִשְׁכַּן כְּבוֹדֶךָ. וְעַל מַלְכוּת בֵּית דָּוִד מְשִׁיחֶךָ. וְעַל מְכוֹנְךָ וְהֵיכָלֶךָ:

עוֹד יִזְכָּר לָנוּ אַהֲבַת אֵיתָן, אֲדוֹנֵינוּ. וּבֵן הַנֶּעֱקָד יַשְׁבִּית מְדַיְּנֵנוּ. וּבִזְכוּת הַתָּם יוֹצִיא אָיוֹם (נ״א היום) לְצֶדֶק דִּינֵנוּ. כִּי קָדוֹשׁ הַיּוֹם לַאֲדֹנֵינוּ: בְּאֵין מֵלִיץ יֹשֶׁר מוּל מָגִּיד פֶּשַׁע. תַּגִּיד לְיַעֲקֹב דָּבָר חק וּמִשְׁפָּט. וְצַדְּקֵנוּ בְּמִשְׁפָּט הַמֶּלֶךְ הַמִּשְׁפָּט.
פותחים הארון. חזן. ע״ס א״ב כפול. קהל.
הָאוֹחֵז בְּיַד מִדַּת מִשְׁפָּט: וְכֹל מַאֲמִינִים שֶׁהוּא אֵל אֱמוּנָה:
הַבּוֹחֵן וּבוֹדֵק גִּנְזֵי נִסְתָּרוֹת: וְ״מַ שֶׁהוּא בּוֹחֵן כְּלָיוֹת:
הַגּוֹאֵל מִמָּוֶת וּפוֹדֶה מִשַּׁחַת: וְ״מַ שֶׁהוּא גּוֹאֵל חָזָק:
הַדָּן יְחִידִי לְבָאֵי עוֹלָם: וְ״מַ שֶׁהוּא דַּיַּן אֱמֶת:
הֶהָגוּי בְּאֶהְיֶה אֲשֶׁר אֶהְיֶה: וְמַ״ שֶׁהָיָה (וְהֹוֶה) וְיִהְיֶה:
הַוַּדַּי שְׁמוֹ כֵּן תְּהִלָּתוֹ: וְ״מַ שֶׁהוּא וְאֵין בִּלְתּוֹ:
הַזּוֹכֵר לְמַזְכִּירָיו טוֹבוֹת זִכְרוֹנוֹת: וְ״מַ שֶׁהוּא זוֹכֵר הַבְּרִית:
הַחוֹתֵךְ חַיִּים לְכָל־חָי: וְ״מַ שֶׁהוּא חַי וְקַיָּם:
הַטּוֹב וּמֵטִיב לָרָעִים וְלַטּוֹבִים: וְ״מַ שֶׁהוּא טוֹב לַכֹּל:
הַיּוֹדֵעַ יֵצֶר כָּל יְצוּרִים: וְ״מַ שֶׁהוּא יוֹצְרָם בַּבָּטֶן:
הַכֹּל יוֹכָל וְכֹלֲלָם יַחַד: וְ״מַ שֶׁהוּא כֹּל יוֹכָל:
הַלָּן בְּסֵתֶר בְּצֵל, שַׁדַּי: וְ״מַ שֶׁהוּא לְבַדּוֹ הוּא:
הַמַּמְלִיךְ מְלָכִים וְלוֹ הַמְּלוּכָה: וְ״מַ שֶׁהוּא מֶלֶךְ עוֹלָם:
הַנּוֹהֵג בְּחַסְדּוֹ כָּל־דּוֹר: וְ״מַ שֶׁהוּא נוֹצֵר חֶסֶד:
הַסּוֹבֵל וּמַעֲלִים עַיִן מִסּוֹרֲרִים: וְ״מַ שֶׁהוּא סוֹלֵחַ סֶלָה:
הָעֶלְיוֹן, וְעֵינוֹ אֶל יְרֵאָיו: וְ״מַ שֶׁהוּא עוֹנֶה לָחַשׁ:
One is our God, He is our father, He is our king, He is our helper; He will again let us hear in His mercy before the eyes of all the living: ‘To be God unto you’.
I am the Lord your God.
O Mighty One, our Mighty One, O Lord, our Lord, how mighty is Thy Name over the whole earth. The Lord will be King over the whole earth, on that day will the Lord be One and His Name One.

The fame of Thine honour makes Thee feared upon the whole earth. When Thou didst make judgment heard from heaven, the earth shook before it returned to its rest. Before the storm on the day of judgment, the floods of the earth roared. There was a mighty Shofar blast, then the Lord spoke and called to the earth, the end of the earth proclaimed the beauty of the righteous God in a song of praise. Fear, fright, dread and terror will then take hold of the earth when Thou arisest for judgment, to show anger with all the ends of the earth. ‘Make straight, clear the way’ those who tremble at the earth’s shaking will say. O luminous and mighty One, Thou wilt reassure the earth: ‘what do you fear, O earth, let the depths of the earth rejoice’.
That it may be known and revealed that He is King over the whole earth; just as He was always praised in heaven, so shall His tested ones acquire the right to praise Him on earth.
O Mighty One, our Mighty One, O Lord, our Lord, how mighty is Thy Name over the whole earth. The Lord will be King over the whole earth, on that day will the Lord be One and His Name One.
And in Thy holy words it is written saying:
The Lord will reign in eternity, your God, O Zion, from generation to generation, Halleluyah.

From generation to generation we will proclaim Thy greatness and for all eternity sanctify Thy holiness. Thy praise, O our God, shall not depart from our mouth for ever and ever, for Thou art God, a great and holy King.

For those who sanctify Thee, hast Thou sanctified with Thy holiness. Glorification by holy ones is becoming to the Holy One. Therefore, let Thy Name, O Lord our God, be sanctified over Israel Thy people, over Jerusalem, Thy city,

over Zion the dwelling of Thy glory, over the kingdom of the house of David Thine anointed, and over Thy residence and Thy sanctuary. Our Lord will yet remember on our behalf the love of the immortal (Abraham), and for the sake of the son (Isaac) who let himself be bound for the sacrifice, He will make an end of our accusers, and through the merit of the innocent (Jacob) will the Awe-inspiring One pronounce our righteous verdict for this day is holy to our Lord. When no defender confronts the accuser, Thou wilt pronounce for Jacob statute and judgment, justify us then in judgment, O King of judgment.
In His hand He holds the attribute of judgment. All believe that He is God of faith.
He tests and examines hidden secrets. All believe that He tests the inwards.
He redeems from death and delivers from destruction. All believe that He is a strong redeemer.
He judges alone those who come into the world. All believe that He is judge of truth.
He is thought of as ‘I am that I am’. All believe that He was, is and shall be.
Sure is His Name and likewise His fame. All believe that He is with none beside Him.
He remembers those who remember Him in kind memory. All believe that He remembers the covenant.
He distributes life to all the living. All believe that He lives and endures.
He is good and acts well towards evil and good. All believe that He is good towards all.
He knows the impulse of all creatures. All believe that He has formed them in the womb.
He has power over all and contains them all. All believe that He has power over all.
Almighty, He dwells in mystery, in shadow. All believe that He alone is He.
He appoints kings and His is the kingdom. All believe that He is King of the world.
He leads with His mercy every generation. All believe that He retains kindness.
He is long suffering and hides His eye from the stubborn. All believe that He grants pardon.
He is supreme and His eye rests on those who fear Him. All believe that He answers soft prayer.
